origin.description: Create a directory and delete it when the frame exits.

arguments.name: tmpdir
arguments.text: Directory that holds the new one.

arguments.name: clean
arguments.text: Delete the directory on exit when TRUE.

origin.details: clean = FALSE leaves the directory in place. pattern, tmpdir, and fileext match tempfile().

translation.description: Create a directory and delete it when the frame exits.

arguments.name: tmpdir
arguments.text: Directory that holds the new one.

arguments.name: clean
arguments.text: Delete the directory on exit when TRUE.

translation.details: clean = FALSE leaves the directory in place. pattern, tmpdir, and fileext match tempfile(). code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

with local_tempdir() as path:
    exists = os.path.isdir(path)
if not exists:
    return "missing"
return "gone" if not os.path.exists(path) else "kept"
